Meta.Purpose: Generate a comprehensive chapter and section hierarchy for a C++ learning subject
Meta.Audience: Beginner to advanced C++ developers, computer science students, systems programmers
Meta.Depth: From first program to modern C++23, with practical real-world applications

Level1.name: Chapter
Level1.Instruction: List all major chapters. Each chapter is a self-contained conceptual unit.
Level1.Fields: title, motivation, real_world_relevance, prerequisite_chapters, code_examples[], compiler_flags[], key_standard_references[]

Level2.name: Section
Level2.Instruction: For each chapter, list all sections. Each section covers one C++ concept or technique.
Level2.Fields: title, intuition, syntax_pattern, key_rules[], common_errors[], visualizations[], difficulty

Level3.name: SubSection
Level3.Instruction: For each section, list sub-sections covering examples, gotchas, and exercises.

OutputFormat.Schema: JSON with nested chapters → sections → subsections
